claims.statement: Management expects GMA contribution in the current financial year to be equal to or better than FY 24.
claims.quote: With a reasonable confidence, I can say that, this financial year will be equal to or better than FY '24 GMA contribution.
claims.speaker: management
claims.target: equal to or better than FY 24

claims.statement: Management aims to grow DMart Ready faster in large towns to achieve a delivery time of at least 12 hours.
claims.quote: primarily growing faster than what we are doing right now in large towns in DMart Ready is the way to go.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management states that blended average gross margins will continue to range between 14.5%, 15%, and 15.5%.
claims.quote: I think 14.5%, 15%, 15.5%, those are the kind of ranges we play in from a gross margin standpoint.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: DMart Ready EBITDA margins are currently at minus 2% to minus 3%.
facts.quote: EBITDA margin is still minus 2% to minus 3%.

facts.statement: 29% of DMart's store cohorts are located in towns with a population of less than 5 lakhs.
facts.quote: So we have 29% of our store cohorts in less than 5 lakh population towns.

facts.statement: The Mumbai Metropolitan Region is fully covered by DMart Ready except for a couple of unserviceable pin codes.
facts.quote: MMR, Mumbai Metropolitan Region, we are fully covered.
